body:
This Halloween week, GFN Thursday is delivering a fresh batch of gaming treats.

Something wicked this blade comes. S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero launches on GeForce NOW today, bringing a scarily good blend of martial arts and punk fantasy to the cloud.

There’s also something on the horizon for adventurers: World of Warcraft: Forever arrives Wednesday, Nov. 4 at 3 p.m. PST, with a launch-week access reward coming for GeForce NOW members.

This week’s lineup also includes nine games streaming from the GeForce NOW library , alongside new mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered . That means more options to play, with no downloads or installs to haunt gamers’ devices .

There’s another sweet update for gamers in India: The option to sign up for four-month Performance and Ultimate memberships is launching tomorrow. Visit the GeForce NOW website for more information.

## Cold Steel Meets Cloud Power

Framed for his master’s murder and gravely wounded, a warrior named Soul has 66 days to uncover a conspiracy threatening the martial world in S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero . Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game combines wuxia storytelling with cinematic action.

Master more than 30 primary weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges, chaining evasions, deflections and counterattacks into fluid combat. Traditional Chinese martial arts meet mechanical prosthetics, industrial ruins and rock music in a distinctive kungfupunk world.

Ultimate members can wield GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud across PCs, Macs, handhelds, mobile devices, browsers, compatible TVs and more. GeForce NOW handles the game’s downloads and storage, leaving more time for the next clash. Soul’s clock is ticking, but the download bar doesn’t have to. Cut to the chase and hop into the game today.

## Azeroth Awaits

Get ready for Blizzard Entertainment’s World of Warcraft: Forever , arriving Wednesday, Nov. 4, at 3 p.m. PT, on GeForce NOW. Explore an iconic world reimagined with new and expanded zones, new gameplay enhancements, upgraded graphics and more.

A new reward will give eligible GeForce NOW members access to join beginning at launch and ending Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 11:59 p.m. PT. The reward is available across all GeForce NOW membership tiers for new WoW users who don’t already have a subscription, while supplies last, on a first-come, first-served basis.

Once available, members can sign in to their GeForce NOW account and head to the Account Portal to redeem. Mark the calendar and gather the party — launch week is approaching.

## New Tricks and Treats

Familiar favorites have a few new tricks, too: Mod.io support is now available directly in game for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered , bringing more ways to make Night City and the Continent feel different.

And the treats keep coming with the following games joining the GeForce NOW library this week:

• Phantom Blade Zero (New release on Steam , Oct. 28)

• ATMOSFAR (New release on Steam , Oct. 29)

• Hunting Simulator 3 (New release on Steam , Oct. 29)

• Queen’s Domain (New release on Steam , Oct. 30)

• Halloween ( Epic Games Store )

• Hell Let Loose: Vietnam ( Epic Games Store )

• The Seance of Blake Manor ( Steam )

Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after they’re released and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates to announced titles.

Settle in for a scary-good gaming session: Grab a day pass to experience Performance or Ultimate cloud gaming. Gamers can then apply the cost applicable toward a first monthly membership upgrade.

What’s haunting the gaming playlist this weekend? Let us know on X or in the comments below.
